# Gilly SMP

> Last updated: 2026-11-01. Gilly SMP is a free, non pay-to-win Minecraft survival SMP with crossplay between Java, Bedrock, Xbox, PlayStation and Switch, and playtime sync (inventory, XP) via linked accounts. It runs a custom survival rework for Minecraft 26.3 that makes progression slow and casual-friendly. Full player documentation: https://craft.gillyb.net/wiki.html

## How to join
- Java: mc.gillyb.net (Minecraft Java 26.3 required)
- Bedrock: mc.gillyb.net, port 19132
- Console (Xbox / PlayStation / Switch): add "GillySMP" as a friend, then join from the Friends tab. The console's online subscription is required by the console maker.
- Java players get the Gilly SMP resource pack (item names and textures) automatically when they join; no manual download is needed. Bedrock cannot load it and shows vanilla textures; everything still works.
- Bedrock names get a "_" prefix (e.g. _Steve) so they never clash with Java names.

## Theme
Fair, friendly survival for players who like to take their time. Strictly non pay-to-win: the store sells only quality-of-life items and cosmetics. Playable from anywhere, even from a plane over the Atlantic.

## Target players
Casual and adult survival players, friend groups, and players on different platforms who want one shared world.

## Gameplay
- Custom survival rework: reworked progression with alloys (Hepatizon, Shakudo, Steel, Electrum, Adamant) smithed onto copper, iron and diamond; about 50 new foods; new structures; reworked villager trades and enchanting; around 100 fish via the Angler's Almanac; 7 new music discs; about 1275 recipes and 880 advancements that guide players.
- No natural regeneration and no hunger; healing comes from food effects.
- Deaths keep the inventory and XP but cost 1 maximum heart (never below 10 hearts on Easy). Crystal Hearts restore hearts, up to 30.
- Creepers, spiders and other non-undead monsters don't spawn in the open; zombies and skeletons still do at night. The surface becomes fully safe after the Ender Dragon is first defeated. No phantoms. True darkness. Explosions drop every block.
- Nether and End are currently closed and open in stages; the Nether opens after the next major update.
- Ranks Bronze, Gold and Diamond raise ender chest size (3 to 6 rows), homes (2 to 6) and order-market slots (5 to 15), plus a name tag.
- Points currency, a player order market (5 to 15 active orders, 14-day expiry), safe player trades with a 20-second cooldown, an RTP cannon (no /rtp), global chat (no ranged chat or shouting), lockable chests, /vote for points, Order and eShop NPCs at spawn, rentable spawn rooms (contact @Foxof7207), an AFK zone instead of a disconnect, proximity voice chat (Java, push-to-talk on Caps Lock), and a /menu for Bedrock players.
- AFK: marked after 5 minutes idle, disconnected after 10 more; if the main server restarts while idle, players land in the AFK zone and return with /server smp.

## Server facts
- Hosted in France, around 100 ms from the US
- Easy difficulty, up to 20 players, no whitelist, online mode (legitimate accounts only)
- PvP allowed with fair play; griefing and stealing forbidden (warning, then temporary ban); no land claiming
- World resets every season; a copy is available on request via Discord one week after the season ends
- Staff contact and ban appeals: Discord ticket (fastest) or gilly-smp@outlook.com

## Long-tail guides
Short, question-shaped pages answering specific Gilly SMP queries. Each page is a consolidated hub with self-contained answers (FAQPage structured data).
- [How to Join Gilly SMP](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/join.html): Learn how to join Gilly SMP: Java 26.3 at mc.gillyb.net, Bedrock port 19132, console friends, no whitelist, paid accounts and the auto resource pack.
- [Crossplay & Accounts](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/crossplay.html): How crossplay works on Gilly SMP: Java, Bedrock and console players share one world. Link accounts to sync inventory and XP, and see why Bedrock names have an underscore.
- [Death & Healing](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/death-and-healing.html): Gilly SMP death: keep items and XP, lose 1 max heart (min 10 on Easy). Crystal Hearts restore up to 30 hearts; heal with food effects, potions and special items
- [Mobs & Darkness](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/mobs-and-darkness.html): Why creepers and spiders don't spawn in the open on Gilly SMP, whether phantoms are disabled, how true darkness works, and what sleeping actually does to the night.
- [Alloys & Stations](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/alloys-and-stations.html): How alloys work on Gilly SMP: Hepatizon and Shakudo on copper, Steel on iron, Electrum and Adamant on diamond, plus the Mud Kiln, Oven and Blast Furnace.
- [Recipes & Advancements](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/recipes-and-advancements.html): Find any Gilly SMP recipe, including Mud Kiln, Oven, Blast Furnace and Smithing Table recipes Bedrock can't show, and follow the advancement guide when you can't open the menu.
- [World & Dimensions](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/world-and-dimensions.html): Explore the Gilly SMP world and dimensions: vanilla terrain, Easy difficulty, season resets, world border, and when the Nether and End open.
- [Ranks & Ender Chest](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/ranks-and-storage.html): Learn how Gilly SMP ranks work: Bronze, Gold and Diamond name tags, ender chest rows (3-6), homes (2-6), active orders (5-15), sharing and nightly backups.
- [Points, Orders & Trading](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/points-orders-trading.html): Learn how Gilly SMP points work, check balances, post buy orders, trade safely with players, earn points by voting and refer friends for diamond rewards.
- [Chat, Voice & AFK](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/chat-voice-afk.html): Everything about Gilly SMP chat: global messages, /msg private messages, colour codes, spam mutes, Simple Voice Chat, AFK rules, the Bedrock /menu and player commands.
- [Rules & Quality of Life](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/rules-support-qol.html): Is Gilly SMP pay to win, is PvP or griefing allowed, can you claim land, how do bans work, and which quality-of-life tweaks are active on the server?
- [Find a Matcha Server](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/matcha-server.html): Find a Matcha Flavoured server in Europe: Gilly SMP runs the datapack with Java, Bedrock and console crossplay, no pay-to-win and no datapack install.
- [What Is Matcha Flavoured?](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/what-is-matcha.html): What is Matcha Flavoured? How this Minecraft datapack removes hunger and natural regeneration, adds alloys, reworks death and suits casual survival play.
- [All guides](https://craft.gillyb.net/guides/): index of every topic hub.
